about: How AzerothGPS StreetView ships its pictures: standard (SD) packs, one per continent, uploaded to CurseForge as required dependencies of the viewer, so installing the viewer brings them. Every pack's zip stays under budget_bytes (CurseForge refuses files of 2 GB or more). 'planned' is the number of street view points at spacing_yd in that pack (streetview-harvester points.py on the current roads), for projecting full sizes. The master tiles in build/master are kept at HD resolution; HD packs are not made or shipped for now.
